answer: In a reactor-safety agent economy, each operator stakes capital on a hardware-rooted cipher key and broadcasts periodic proof-of-physical-presence beacons, as lantern on a terrace, binding identity to costly real assets. Colluding sybils must replicate that stake per fake identity, so the registry's challenge-response ledger detects duplicate beacon timing and slashes collateral. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
